label: 🖼️ IMAGEN / CONCEPTO, TODAVÍA HAY QUE CONSTRUIRLO — procedural 0 CU
files: ter_<name>_albedo_height.webp (RGB albedo sRGB, A = height linear 0..1), ter_<name>_normal.webp (OpenGL +Y, tangent space; Godot default), ter_<name>_orm.webp (R=AO, G=roughness, B=metallic=0, linear)
tiling: all maps generated periodic (FFT noise, periodic Voronoi, wrapped strokes); seam_edge_diff ~= interior_neighbour_diff on every map = seamless; see ter_<name>_tile2x2_preview.jpg
height_blend: weight_i = max(0, height_i + splat_i - max_j(height_j + splat_j) + 0.15); suggested contrast 0.1-0.2. Height scale is comparable across materials: lush grass/cobble stones ~0.7-0.9 tops, mud ~0.2-0.4 so mud settles into joints and low ground.
lighting: mild upper-left light and AO baked into albedo for the gritty read; lit at runtime as normal

cobblestone.blend: stones tall, joints low: dirt/mud height-blend into the joints first

dirt_path.blend: low/medium height; grass edges bleed in by height+noise mask; mud fills its low areas

grass_lush.use: meadows, outside the walls, riverbanks top
grass_lush.blend: tallest material: wins height-blends against short grass/dirt; pair with grass card scatter

grass_short.blend: height-blend over dirt_path: bare soil patches (low alpha) give way first

mud.use: wet low ground, near millrace, gate approach, livestock pens
mud.blend: lowest height: always sits under others; puddles = low roughness where height<0.3

plaza_flagstones.use: central plaza, around fountain/gazebo, castle forecourt
plaza_flagstones.blend: slabs flat-high, joints low; grime/dirt blends into joints

riverbank_pebbles.use: river edges, under the bridge, millrace banks
riverbank_pebbles.blend: rounded pebbles high; sand low; wet darkening zones lower roughness - bias wet zone toward water side

wall_base_gravel.use: 1-2 m strip at the foot of the city wall, towers, gatehouse
wall_base_gravel.blend: angular gravel mid height; dirt patches low; weeds at wall line
